Open Nozzle · Standard & Impingement Configurations

Water Mist Nozzles

A chrome-plated copper open-nozzle range for water-mist and water-spray systems. Standard models are available from DN15 to DN25, while current impingement models are listed in DN15 and DN20. Stainless-steel ZSTWB options are listed separately with their own thread, K-factor and spray-angle specifications.
